items.title: What Changed In Marvell's Story?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock returned 201% in the past year, against 17.7% for the S&P 500. Investors value it as an AI data center chip company at 85.6 times earnings, versus 22.1 for the S&P 500. Investors paying that multiple are counting on data center growth staying fast. Management used to tell a second growth story too, and it no longer leads with that story. So what did Marvell's management stop leading with.
